# DiTech Solutions & Services

> AI-powered automation, workflow orchestration, and custom software for law firms and SMEs.

DiTech builds intelligent automation, legal-tech solutions, and full-stack applications. We help legal professionals and enterprises modernize through AI, n8n workflows, and bespoke development.
